'''Evelyn Lanto''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Lanto was born as '''Carrie Keranen''' on January 16, 1987. She first joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} in [[S07|the seventh season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}, providing additional voices until {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. She later returned in the {{aniseries|DP|''Diamond and Pearl'' series}} episode ''[[DP063|Hot Springing a Leak!]]''. She is credited under the names of '''Caroline Hellman''' in the seventh season, '''Caroline Lawson''' in the {{aniseries|AG|''Ruby and Sapphire'' series}} episode ''[[AG095|The Evolutionary War]]'', and '''Evelyn Lanto''' from ''[[AG107|Absol-ute Disaster]]'' onwards. Lanto is currently affiliated with AVO Talent Agency.
